reviews.title: Sleek desk pad with good comfort
reviews.comment:
This desk pad looks great on my desk—the brightness of the black PU leather gives it a professional, clean look. The slip resistance is excellent; it stays in place even with a lot of movement on top.
It’s comfortable to write on and use my laptop, so the comfort and overall use are very good. The stickiness isn’t too much, which is perfect—it doesn’t leave marks but still grips the desk. Setting it up was simple, so ease of use is straightforward.
Overall, it’s a practical and stylish desk pad that protects the desk and feels nice to work on.
reviews.author: Elian Diaz

reviews.title: Affordable, pretty, simple… & lifetime warranty if you use QR Code?! SOLD!!
reviews.comment:
This product is extremely true to color, which is always a relief to see.. I bought the light pink. It comes rolled up, but the company gives you technique on how to fix it to be straightened out.
I truly wasn’t going to leave a review until I saw the paper included with the mousepad that said: “We offer a lifetime warranty for loyal users. No matter how long you’ve used it, if any issues arise, we’ll send you a new replacement for free.”
That is something to note, and I have definitely signed up for that warranty with their website. Similar products typically get worn down super fast and I have to replace it often. I haven’t had a long mousepad like this before, but this one is pretty nice. No weird smells (BIG worry always, I have sensory sensitivities to smells) and very clean appearance. It truly feels like leather, I have no clue what material it ACTUALLY is though.  The price is amazing too, so I highly recommend this product! The pink isn’t too light to see that it’s pink, but not too dark to be considered normal pink. I marked any personally identifying aspects out of my picture taken for safety reasons.
reviews.author: Meg, Cat Mom of 3

reviews.title: Very nice product
reviews.comment: Exactly the size I needed. The color was great. After unrolling it from the package it took a couple of days, but now it sets flat on my desk without issue. Quality it great, thick & non-slip. Blocks the seam on the desk perfectly. Fits a keyboard & mouse with ease.
reviews.author: Ashleigh

reviews.title: A nice desk cover!
reviews.comment:
Overall this is a really nice desk pad. The material feels smooth and good quality, and it makes my desk look much more organized and put together. It’s large enough to fit my keyboard and mouse comfortably, and the surface works great as a mouse pad.
The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the color wasn’t exactly what I expected. I ordered a beige tone, but in person it looks a little more pink than beige. It’s still nice, just not quite the color shown in the listing.
Aside from the color difference, it’s a great desk mat and I’m happy with the quality and size. I got the 36x17.
reviews.author: Shelby

reviews.title: Absolutely Love This Desk Mat!
reviews.comment:
I received this item as a gift and couldn’t be happier with it. It’s extremely easy to use and has plenty of space for my keyboard, mouse, and even my cup of coffee without feeling crowded. The quality is excellent—the material feels durable yet comfortable, making it great for everyday use. I also love how slightly sticky it is, which keeps it securely in place on my desk without slipping.
When I first rolled it out, it didn’t lay completely flat, but after placing something heavy on it for a bit, it flattened perfectly and has stayed that way ever since. Now it makes my desk look sleek, cute, and much more put‑together. My only regret is not ordering the larger size to cover more surface area.
Overall, this was an amazing find. With the lifetime warranty and overall comfort and quality, it’s hard not to recommend it. If you’re on the fence—give it a try. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Briana F.
